name: Minazuki Reia
source:
A girl who has known Misa for quite a long time, but apparently they don't get along well with each other. They frequently have fights for whatever reasons they imagine. 

She "saves" and helps Mikami Hisashi when he needs it the most, and signs a "contract" with him.
